title: Matrix Operations
seo_title: Matrix Operations Worksheet: Add, Subtract and Multiply Matrices | 100 Questions
standard_text: Add, subtract, and multiply matrices of appropriate dimensions.
meta_desc: Free precalculus worksheet on matrix operations: adding and subtracting, scalar multiplication, dimensions of products, multiplying matrices and data problems. 100 questions.
key_big: Multiply row times column. The inside dimensions must match.
key_sub: m × n times n × p gives m × p, and AB ≠ BA in general.
body_html:
How it works

  • A matrix with m rows and n columns is m × n. Add or subtract only matrices of the same size, entry by entry.
  • A scalar multiplies every entry.
  • The product AB is defined when the columns of A equal the rows of B. An m × n times an n × p gives m × p.
  • Each entry of AB is a row of A times a column of B: multiply matching numbers and add. In general AB ≠ BA.
Example

Find 12345012.

Row 1 · column 1: 1(5) + 2(1) = 7; row 1 · column 2: 1(0) + 2(2) = 4

Row 2: 3(5) + 4(1) = 19 and 3(0) + 4(2) = 8

Answer: 74198

Example

A is 3 × 2 and B is 2 × 4. Find the size of AB.

Inside numbers 2 and 2 match

Outside numbers 3 and 4

Answer: 3 × 4

Common mistakes

  • Multiplying entry by entry. Use row times column.
  • Assuming AB = BA. Matrix multiplication is not commutative.
  • Checking the wrong numbers for dimensions. The columns of the first must match the rows of the second.
  • Multiplying a scalar into only some of the entries.

faq.q: How do you multiply two matrices?
faq.a: Each entry of AB is found by multiplying a row of A by a column of B, matching numbers in order and adding the products.

faq.q: When is a matrix product defined?
faq.a: When the number of columns of the first matrix equals the number of rows of the second. An m × n times an n × p matrix is m × p.
No. In general AB and BA are different, and one may be defined when the other is not.

faq.q: How are matrices used in real life?
faq.a: They organize data. For example, a table of items sold times a column of prices gives each seller's total.
